checks.title: CV checks
checks.intro: These checks run as you type and never leave your browser. They test whether software can read your CV, not how well it's written.

ats.capped: The score is capped because of a blocking problem: {title}

coverage.empty: No specific terms could be pulled out of that posting, so it may be mostly boilerplate.
coverage.note: Counted separately from the score. Coverage doesn't predict anything.
coverage.stuffed: Repeated far more often than the posting uses them: {terms}. Heavy repetition can read as keyword stuffing.

fixes.title: Fixes you can apply
fixes.description: Each fix edits your tailored CV with AI. Check the result before you download.

review.disclaimer: This review is a language model's opinion of your writing. It doesn't change the score above, and it can be wrong. Treat it as a second opinion, not a verdict.
review.error: Couldn't review your writing. Try again.
review.title: Review the writing with AI
review.description: The checks above are mechanical. This asks a language model what a reader would think of your bullets, and suggests rewrites. It produces no score.
review.sendsWithJob: Sends your CV text and the job details to Groq, the AI provider FitMyCV uses.
review.sends: Sends your CV text to Groq, the AI provider FitMyCV uses.

MISSING_NAME.title: Your CV has no name.
MISSING_NAME.action: Add your full name under Personal Information.

MISSING_EMAIL.title: Your CV has no email address.
MISSING_EMAIL.action: Add an email address so recruiters can reach you.

MALFORMED_EMAIL.title: This email address is not in a standard form.
MALFORMED_EMAIL.action: Use a plain address such as name@example.com, with no extra text.

MISSING_PHONE.title: Your CV has no phone number.
MISSING_PHONE.action: Add one with its country code. Some application forms ask for it.

MISSING_LOCATION.title: Your CV has no location.
MISSING_LOCATION.action: Add at least a city and country.

MALFORMED_URL.title: This link is missing https://.
MALFORMED_URL.action: Write the full address, including https://.

NO_EXPERIENCE.title: Your CV shows no work experience.
NO_EXPERIENCE.action: Add a position, or use projects and volunteer work to show similar history.

MISSING_DESCRIPTION.title: This position has no description.
MISSING_DESCRIPTION.action: Describe what you did. An empty role adds no keywords for matching.

NO_SKILLS.title: Your CV lists no skills.
NO_SKILLS.action: Add the tools and methods you use.

NO_EDUCATION.title: Your CV has no education.
NO_EDUCATION.action: Add where you studied, or a relevant course or certificate.

NO_SUMMARY.title: Your CV has no summary.
NO_SUMMARY.action: Add two or three lines at the top describing what you do.

MISSING_DATES.title: This entry has no start date.
MISSING_DATES.action: Add a date such as Mar 2022 so it lands on your timeline.

MISSING_END_DATE.title: This position has no end date.
MISSING_END_DATE.action: Write Present if you still work here, or add the month you left.

UNPARSEABLE_DATE.title: This date is written in a form software may not read.
UNPARSEABLE_DATE.action: Use a form such as Mar 2022, 2022-03 or 2022.

REVERSED_PERIOD.title: This entry ends before it starts.
REVERSED_PERIOD.action: Swap the start and end dates.

FUTURE_DATE.title: This date is in the future.
FUTURE_DATE.action: Correct the year, or write Present for ongoing work.

MIXED_DATE_FORMATS.title: Your work dates are written in different ways.
MIXED_DATE_FORMATS.action: Pick one format and use it for every position.

NO_QUANTIFIED_IMPACT.title: Few of your bullets include a number.
NO_QUANTIFIED_IMPACT.action: Add figures where you have them: volumes, percentages, time frames, team sizes.

WEAK_OPENERS.title: Many bullets open with filler such as "Responsible for".
WEAK_OPENERS.action: Start each one with what you did: built, led, reduced, migrated.

FIRST_PERSON_PRONOUNS.title: Your CV uses "I" and "my".
FIRST_PERSON_PRONOUNS.action: Drop the pronouns and start from the verb.

LONG_BULLETS.title: Some bullets run long.
LONG_BULLETS.action: Keep each one to about two lines.

EMPLOYMENT_GAP.title: There is a gap of more than six months between two positions.
EMPLOYMENT_GAP.action: A gap is fine. Add a short line about it only if you want to.
